intents.label: Battery & Power Issues
intents.description: Customer reporting battery draining fast, phone not charging, unexpected shutdowns, battery percentage jumping, or battery health concerns.
examples: @AppleSupport my battery is draining so fast after the iOS 11 update. went from 80% to 10% in an hour
@AppleSupport battery health shows 79% and my phone keeps shutting off randomly. Is this hardware?
@AppleSupport why does my iPhone 6s die at 30% battery? This started after updating

intents.label: iOS Update & Software Bug
intents.description: Customer reporting bugs, glitches, or performance issues introduced after a software update, or asking when a fix will arrive.
examples: @AppleSupport my phone has been super laggy ever since I updated to iOS 11.1
@AppleSupport the keyboard 'I' autocorrect bug is driving me insane. When will this be patched?
Updated to iOS 11 and now my apps keep crashing @AppleSupport please help

intents.label: Apple ID & iCloud Account
intents.description: Customer locked out of Apple ID, iCloud login issues, two-factor authentication problems, forgotten password, or account security concerns.
examples: @AppleSupport I got locked out of my Apple ID and the verification code isn't sending to my phone
@AppleSupport someone hacked my iCloud account, I can see unauthorized sign-ins from another country
@AppleSupport I forgot my Apple ID password and two-factor is going to a number I no longer have

intents.label: Hardware Damage & Repair
intents.description: Customer reporting cracked screen, damaged device, water damage, non-functional home/side buttons, or asking about repair costs and warranty.
examples: @AppleSupport my home button stopped working completely. Is this covered under warranty?
@AppleSupport dropped my iPhone X and the screen cracked. What are my repair options?
@AppleSupport my iPhone got water damaged and now the touch screen is unresponsive

intents.label: App Store, Subscriptions & Billing
intents.description: Customer charged unexpectedly, subscription cancellation issues, refund requests, app purchase problems, or Apple Pay/billing disputes.
examples: @AppleSupport I was charged twice for the same app purchase. Need a refund immediately
@AppleSupport I cancelled a subscription but still got charged for this month
@AppleSupport my child made in-app purchases without my permission, how do I get a refund?

intents.label: Connectivity & Network Issues
intents.description: Customer having Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, mobile data, AirDrop, or cellular connectivity problems on their Apple device.
examples: @AppleSupport my iPhone keeps dropping Wi-Fi every few minutes. Already reset network settings
@AppleSupport AirDrop stopped working after the iOS 11 update. My friends' devices aren't showing up
@AppleSupport Bluetooth audio keeps cutting out on my AirPods when I walk away from my phone

intents.label: Device Setup, Restore & Migration
intents.description: Customer setting up a new device, restoring from backup, transferring data between devices, or facing activation issues.
examples: @AppleSupport got a new iPhone X. How do I restore from my iCloud backup without losing photos?
@AppleSupport my iPhone is stuck on the activation screen after a restore. What should I do?
@AppleSupport trying to transfer WhatsApp from my old iPhone to new one but the backup keeps failing

intents.label: Performance, Storage & Memory
intents.description: Customer experiencing app crashes, device freezing/not responding, storage full warnings, or asking about optimizing device performance.
examples: @AppleSupport my iPhone freezes and becomes completely unresponsive for minutes at a time
@AppleSupport says I have 0 MB of storage but I've deleted almost everything. How?
@AppleSupport apps keep crashing randomly on my iPhone 7. Tried restarting multiple times

intents.label: General Inquiry & Feature Questions
intents.description: Customer asking general how-to questions, feature availability, compatibility questions, or venting frustration without a specific actionable request.
examples: @AppleSupport does iOS 11 support screen recording natively or do I need a third-party app?
@AppleSupport is the iPhone X waterproof? What IP rating does it have?
@AppleSupport how do I enable dark mode? Searched everywhere but can't find it

conditional_escalate_signals: mention of legal action or consumer rights
explicit anger with threats (threatening to switch brands, sue, or contact media)
